supplemental_catalogue_source.note: Inspected for OP-18 and EB-05 reconciliation; PR #38 head is 10 commits ahead of the Stage 3 baseline supplied for this audit branch and was not merged or integrated.

counting_rules: Distinct card numbers are counted from card-entry records, not references inside card effects.
Only card-number-prefix matches count as base cards for OP and EB sets.
Other original card-number prefixes in a product page are additional reprint/product inclusions.
PRB product entries use original OP/EB/ST card numbers; no PRB base count is asserted from those reprints.
A page result count is not a printing identity count; no COMPLETE status is inferred from totals.
Image identifiers are reference matches, not successful HTTP/browser image-load checks.
